table api_key on api_key
CREATE TABLE api_key ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 12), key_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(key_sha256) = 64), persona_id TEXT NOT NULL, class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (class IN ('owner','trusted','public')), label TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT )

table artifact_ref on artifact_ref
CREATE TABLE artifact_ref ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, blob_digest TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES blob(digest) ON DELETE RESTRICT, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, event_id TEXT REFERENCES runtime_event(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL, metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', created_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table blob on blob
CREATE TABLE blob ( digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes >= 0), media_type TEXT NOT NULL, relative_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table broadcast_destination on broadcast_destination
CREATE TABLE broadcast_destination ( alias TEXT PRIMARY KEY, next_eligible_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table broadcast_item on broadcast_item
CREATE TABLE broadcast_item ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, producer TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, content_digest TEXT NOT NULL, priority TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN ('urgent','warning','info')), destination_alias TEXT NOT NULL, content_json TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('held','scheduled','started','succeeded','failed','unknown','cancelled')), not_before TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), effect_id TEXT REFERENCES effect_intent(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, digest_parent_id TEXT REFERENCES broadcast_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(producer, idempotency_key) )

table channel_resume on channel_resume

table child_run on child_run
CREATE TABLE child_run ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, parent_session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, parent_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_invocation_id TEXT NOT NULL, child_session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, durable_key TEXT NOT NULL, context_digest TEXT NOT NULL, grants_json TEXT NOT NULL, budget_json TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled','deadline_exceeded','interrupted')), deadline TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, result_status TEXT, result_output TEXT, result_artifacts_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', tokens_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cost_micros INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, completed_at TEXT, result_provenance TEXT, result_child_id TEXT, result_session_id TEXT, result_context_digest TEXT, result_durable_key TEXT, result_source_range TEXT, result_model TEXT, result_prompt_version TEXT, result_trust TEXT, UNIQUE(parent_invocation_id, idempotency_key) )

table conversation_session on conversation_session
CREATE TABLE conversation_session ( conversation_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table durable_action on durable_action
CREATE TABLE durable_action ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_run(key) ON DELETE CASCADE, action_key TEXT NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('result','failed')), result BLOB NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (run_key, action_key) )

table durable_approval on durable_approval
CREATE TABLE durable_approval ( approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_run(key) ON DELETE CASCADE, consumed_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table durable_host on durable_host
CREATE TABLE durable_host ( owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table durable_run on durable_run
CREATE TABLE durable_run ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, handler TEXT NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('running','succeeded','failed','cancelled')), detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cancel_requested IN (0, 1)), owner TEXT, claim INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table durable_session_turn on durable_session_turn
CREATE TABLE durable_session_turn ( turn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence > 0), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','active')), descriptor_json TEXT NOT NULL, deadline TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (session_id, sequence), FOREIGN KEY (session_id, sequence) REFERENCES runtime_event(session_id, sequence) ON DELETE CASCADE )

table durable_signal on durable_signal
CREATE TABLE durable_signal ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_run(key) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, payload BLOB NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (run_key, name, seq) )

table durable_timer on durable_timer
CREATE TABLE durable_timer ( run_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_run(key) ON DELETE CASCADE, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, fire_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_key, seq) ) WITHOUT ROWID

table durable_wait on durable_wait

table effect_intent on effect_intent
CREATE TABLE effect_intent ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, tool_call_id TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, classification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (classification IN ('read_only','idempotent','effectful','irreversible')), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('prepared','started','succeeded','unknown','failed')), request_digest TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, provider_receipt_json TEXT, safe_error_code TEXT, retry_of TEXT REFERENCES effect_intent(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, prepared_at TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT, finished_at TEXT, reconciled_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT, result_digest TEXT CHECK ((result_json IS NULL) = (result_digest IS NULL) AND (result_json IS NULL OR (state = 'succeeded' AND typeof(result_json) = 'text' AND typeof(result_digest) = 'text' AND json_valid(result_json) AND length(CAST(result_json AS BLOB)) <= 1048576))) , lease_token TEXT, lease_expires_at TEXT, UNIQUE (provider, operation, idempotency_key) )

table workflow_approval on workflow_approval
CREATE TABLE workflow_approval ( definition_id TEXT NOT NULL, definition_version INTEGER NOT NULL, spec_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('installed','proposal','routine')), agent_id TEXT, approver_id TEXT NOT NULL, proposal_id TEXT REFERENCES workflow_proposal(id), source_definition_id TEXT, source_definition_version INTEGER, tainted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tainted IN (0,1)), approved_at TEXT NOT NULL, persona_pins TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(persona_pins)), PRIMARY KEY (definition_id, definition_version), FOREIGN KEY (definition_id, definition_version) REFERENCES workflow_definition(id, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK ((kind = 'proposal') = (proposal_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((kind = 'routine') = (source_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND source_definition_version IS NOT NULL)) )

table workflow_correlation on workflow_correlation
CREATE TABLE workflow_correlation ( source TEXT NOT NULL, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, external_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_run(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, signal_name TEXT NOT NULL, dedupe_key TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (source, event_type, external_id, dedupe_key) )

table workflow_definition on workflow_definition
CREATE TABLE workflow_definition ( id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0), goal TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('defined','composed','generated')), spec_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(spec_json)), spec_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (id, version) )

table workflow_proposal on workflow_proposal
CREATE TABLE workflow_proposal ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, spec_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(spec_json)), spec_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('proposed','approved','rejected','expired')), decided_at TEXT, run_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL , tainted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tainted IN (0,1)), plan_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', reply_channel TEXT CHECK (reply_channel IS NULL OR reply_channel IN ('discord','telegram')), reply_account TEXT, reply_channel_id TEXT, reply_thread_id TEXT CHECK ((reply_channel IS NULL) = (reply_account IS NULL) AND (reply_channel IS NULL) = (reply_channel_id IS NULL) AND (reply_thread_id IS NULL OR reply_channel IS NOT NULL)))

table workflow_run on workflow_run
CREATE TABLE workflow_run ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, definition_id TEXT NOT NULL, definition_version INTEGER NOT NULL, durable_key TEXT UNIQUE, goal TEXT NOT NULL, input_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(input_json)), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( status IN ('queued','running','suspended','succeeded','failed','cancelled') ), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, principal_id TEXT, principal_class TEXT CHECK (principal_class IS NULL OR principal_class IN ('owner','trusted','public')), agent_id TEXT, origin_session_id TEXT, reply_account TEXT, reply_channel_id TEXT, completion_notified_at TEXT, completion_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tainted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tainted IN (0,1)), parent_run_id TEXT REFERENCES workflow_run(id), reply_channel TEXT CHECK (reply_channel IS NULL OR (reply_channel IN ('discord','telegram') AND reply_account IS NOT NULL AND reply_channel_id IS NOT NULL)), reply_thread_id TEXT CHECK (reply_thread_id IS NULL OR reply_channel IS NOT NULL), FOREIGN KEY (definition_id, definition_version) REFERENCES workflow_definition(id, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT )

table workflow_step_run on workflow_step_run
CREATE TABLE workflow_step_run ( run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_run(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, step_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( status IN ('pending','ready','running','succeeded','failed','skipped') ), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt >= 0), started_at TEXT, ended_at TEXT, output_json TEXT CHECK ( output_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(output_json) AND length(output_json) <= 65536) ), output_artifact_digest TEXT, error_code TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, tainted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (tainted IN (0,1)), private INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (private IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY (run_id, step_id) )

trigger kb_chunk_fts_delete on kb_chunk
CREATE TRIGGER kb_chunk_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON kb_chunk BEGIN INSERT INTO kb_chunk_fts(kb_chunk_fts, rowid, content, heading, scope) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.content, old.heading, old.scope); END

trigger kb_chunk_fts_insert on kb_chunk
CREATE TRIGGER kb_chunk_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON kb_chunk BEGIN INSERT INTO kb_chunk_fts(rowid, content, heading, scope) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content, new.heading, new.scope); END

trigger kb_chunk_fts_update on kb_chunk
CREATE TRIGGER kb_chunk_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF content, heading, scope ON kb_chunk BEGIN INSERT INTO kb_chunk_fts(kb_chunk_fts, rowid, content, heading, scope) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.content, old.heading, old.scope); INSERT INTO kb_chunk_fts(rowid, content, heading, scope) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content, new.heading, new.scope); END

trigger memory_document_fts_delete on memory_document
CREATE TRIGGER memory_document_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON memory_document BEGIN INSERT INTO memory_document_fts(memory_document_fts, rowid, content) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.content); END

trigger memory_document_fts_insert on memory_document
CREATE TRIGGER memory_document_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON memory_document BEGIN INSERT INTO memory_document_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content); END

trigger memory_document_fts_update on memory_document
CREATE TRIGGER memory_document_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF content ON memory_document BEGIN INSERT INTO memory_document_fts(memory_document_fts, rowid, content) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.content); INSERT INTO memory_document_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content); END

trigger profile_fact_fts_delete on profile_fact
CREATE TRIGGER profile_fact_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON profile_fact BEGIN INSERT INTO profile_fact_fts(profile_fact_fts, rowid, fact_key, fact_value) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.fact_key, old.fact_value); END

trigger profile_fact_fts_insert on profile_fact
CREATE TRIGGER profile_fact_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON profile_fact BEGIN INSERT INTO profile_fact_fts(rowid, fact_key, fact_value) VALUES (new.rowid, new.fact_key, new.fact_value); END

trigger profile_fact_fts_update on profile_fact
CREATE TRIGGER profile_fact_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF fact_key, fact_value ON profile_fact BEGIN INSERT INTO profile_fact_fts(profile_fact_fts, rowid, fact_key, fact_value) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.fact_key, old.fact_value); INSERT INTO profile_fact_fts(rowid, fact_key, fact_value) VALUES (new.rowid, new.fact_key, new.fact_value); END

trigger workflow_approval_persona_pins_immutable on workflow_approval
CREATE TRIGGER workflow_approval_persona_pins_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF persona_pins ON workflow_approval BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workflow_approval.persona_pins is immutable'); END

trigger workflow_proposal_plan_text_immutable on workflow_proposal
CREATE TRIGGER workflow_proposal_plan_text_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF plan_text ON workflow_proposal WHEN NEW.plan_text IS NOT OLD.plan_text BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workflow_proposal.plan_text is immutable'); END

trigger workflow_run_reply_target_insert on workflow_run
CREATE TRIGGER workflow_run_reply_target_insert BEFORE INSERT ON workflow_run WHEN NEW.reply_channel IS NULL AND (NEW.reply_account IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reply_channel_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workflow_run reply target is partial'); END

trigger workflow_run_reply_target_update on workflow_run
CREATE TRIGGER workflow_run_reply_target_update BEFORE UPDATE OF reply_channel, reply_account, reply_channel_id ON workflow_run WHEN NEW.reply_channel IS NULL AND (NEW.reply_account IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reply_channel_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workflow_run reply target is partial'); END
